value.text:
q15.

The three tables are backed by plain structs in the `store` package (this repo uses hand-written SQL per driver rather than an ORM, so there are no `TableName()` methods — the mapping is visible in the driver statements that reference each table).

| Table | Struct — path |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | `store.User` — `store/user.go` (line 29) |
| `attachment` | `store.Attachment` — `store/attachment.go` (line 16) |
| `reaction` | `store.Reaction` — `store/reaction.go` (line 7) |

Evidence for the mapping comes from the driver layer, where each struct is read/written against the matching table name, e.g. `INSERT INTO user (...)` with `*store.User` in `store/db/sqlite/user.go`, ``INSERT INTO `attachment` `` with `*store.Attachment` in `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go`, and ``INSERT INTO `reaction` `` with `*store.Reaction` in `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go`. Parallel implementations exist under `store/db/mysql/` and `store/db/postgres/`.
